title: New Category creates nothing until Save, and Cancel creates nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note the number of categories the Categories page shows (for example 17).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click New Category.
  3. Type a name no other category uses.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Click Discard Changes.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows the noted count.

Step 2:

  • The New Category page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 4:

  • A question asks whether to discard the changes, with Keep Editing and Discard Changes.

Step 5:

  • The Categories list shows again.
  • The count is still the noted number (17 = 17) and the typed name is not listed.
